safe_mechanisms.name: BGAppRefreshTask / SwiftUI appRefresh
safe_mechanisms.use_for: short refresh and state update jobs that iOS may schedule opportunistically
safe_mechanisms.limits: system scheduled; short runtime; not guaranteed at exact time

safe_mechanisms.name: BGProcessingTask
safe_mechanisms.use_for: longer maintenance/data-processing jobs while the device is idle
safe_mechanisms.limits: interruptible; requires processing background mode; not a permanent daemon

safe_mechanisms.name: BGContinuedProcessingTask
safe_mechanisms.use_for: user-started work that can continue after the app is backgrounded
safe_mechanisms.limits: must start from foreground/user action; progress/cancel behavior required

safe_mechanisms.name: Background URLSession
safe_mechanisms.use_for: system-managed uploads/downloads that continue when the app is suspended
safe_mechanisms.limits: network transfer only; completion delivered by system

safe_mechanisms.name: App Extensions
safe_mechanisms.use_for: Share Sheet, File Provider, Widget, Intent/App Intent, Notification Service, Spotlight indexing
safe_mechanisms.limits: separate extension bundles with constrained APIs and lifecycle

safe_mechanisms.name: App Groups / shared container
safe_mechanisms.use_for: safe data exchange between app and its extensions
safe_mechanisms.limits: only within same developer team/app group entitlement

safe_mechanisms.name: Shortcuts / App Intents
safe_mechanisms.use_for: user-visible automation entry points outside the app UI
safe_mechanisms.limits: user-configured or user-approved automation; no hidden daemon behavior

safe_mechanisms.name: Local/LAN Gateway Pairing
safe_mechanisms.use_for: iPhone controls a reachable local service with explicit owner token
safe_mechanisms.limits: LAN/local only unless separately deployed behind proper auth/TLS
